Example Federal Credit Union opens its fourteenth branch

ANYTOWN, ST, January 20, 2026 — Example Federal Credit Union opened its fourteenth branch on Monday in the Northside district.

The 2,400 square foot branch uses a universal banker model and includes two interactive teller machines available outside lobby hours.
